title: Z21 dissector - add new commands
description:
The Z21 UDP protocol received some updates lately:
https://www.z21.eu/media/Kwc_Basic_DownloadTag_Component/root-en-main_47-1652-959-downloadTag-download/default/d559b9cf/1628743384/z21-lan-protokoll-en.pdf

I've added the commands
- LAN_GET_HWINFO
- LAN_GET_LOCOMODE
- LAN_SET_LOCOMODE
- LAN_SYSTEMSTATE_GETDATA
- LAN_GET_BROADCASTFLAGS
- LAN_SET_BROADCASTFLAGS
